positions.name: S1 (Theogony)
positions.description: Born from sea-foam around Ouranos's severed member

how_we_present_it: Two birth-accounts side by side; neither is declared 'the' truth.
Both stored; the Iliad's 'Hera alone' is the more distinctive account.

positions.name: Cult (local)
positions.description: Deities had local identities that predate and differ from the classical syncretic pantheon

how_we_present_it: We note where a deity's 'family position' is a literary synthesis vs. a local cult reality.

positions.name: Orphic
positions.description: A cosmic egg and the god Phanes

how_we_present_it: Both cosmogonies presented as variants, not merged.
We flag the passage as likely interpolated, per the scholarly consensus.

positions.name: Hesiodic
positions.description: Monstrous Gorgon from birth (daughter of Phorcys & Ceto)

positions.name: Ovid (later)
positions.description: A beautiful maiden transformed (for hubris / an offense against Athena)

how_we_present_it: Both versions stored; the 'maiden' version is dated as later (Roman).
